I'm working on a Windows laptop with an Intel CPU and I need help configuring the Windows power plan for better battery life. The laptop uses Connected Standby (Modern Standby) and I want to optimize the DRIPS (Deepest Runtime Idle Platform State) residency. Can you help me tune the powercfg settings?

Output from powercfg /sleepstudy:
  Modern Standby: Capable
  DRIPS residency: 45%
  Top offenders:
    Wi-Fi (Intel AX211): 30% active time
    USB Hub: 15% active time
    Audio device: 10% active time
